$comment: B1.5c query-time title alias table. FROZEN EMPTY (decision C10): no Chinese translated title is pre-seeded, so a cold G1-T run can only recover a CJK title through the LLM candidate step + catalog verification. Entries are produced at run time by the resolver and are recorded with the evidence that produced them; they are never evaluation seeds.

zh_title.description: the user-visible Chinese title, as resolved

movie_id.description: catalog id the title was verified against (VARCHAR(10), no assumed prefix)

source.description: what produced the candidate: 'llm-candidate' | 'catalog-exact' | 'catalog-prefix' | 'manual-review'; a run-time resolver record is required

verified_by.description: the exact command or SQL that proved the mapping against the catalog, e.g. SELECT id,title,year FROM movies WHERE title = 'Rear Window'

rules: An entry may only be written after the candidate passed catalog verification (exact match preferred, prefix match second); unverified candidates are never stored.
Every entry carries source + verified_by + verified_at; an entry without them is invalid and check_schema.py rejects non-empty entries that lack the fields.
The table is frozen empty for the B1.5c measurement (C10). Choosing to pre-seed entries would bump aliases_version and invalidate the case for using that run as generalization evidence.
Held-out CJK cases must not appear here: scripts/eval/check_heldout.py asserts both held-out CJK titles are absent, before and after the run.
notes: C10 (main agent, 2026-11-19): freeze empty. Q21-Q23 (黑客帝国 / 阿甘正传 / 泰坦尼克号) must NOT be pre-seeded; Chinese recovery may only come from G1-T step 2 (LLM candidates) plus step 3 (catalog verification).
No external alias data (Wikidata/TMDB/IMDb akas) is used: that data source plus its licence is still unapproved (WU-9 in docs/architecture/ai-user-workflows.md §9).
The resolver cache is a run artifact (.pi/artifacts/), not this file: within-run reuse never changes what this table contains.
